app.title: Komitake
app.tagline: Go server to connect and drive the fuji Wi-Fi RC kart

fullscreen.promptDescription: This version of Safari doesn't support DOM fullscreen. Open a new tab for a similar experience?

landing.connectingDescription: Waiting for the current connected-kart snapshot.
landing.kartUnavailableDescription: No connected kart uniquely matches "{{slug}}". Select another kart from the top bar.
landing.selectKartDescription: Select a kart to monitor and drive.
landing.noKartsDescription: Pair a kart to begin monitoring.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The requested page does not exist.

video.chooseKart: Choose a connected kart to view its shared live video stream.
video.webrtcFailedSuggestion: WebRTC could not connect. Try switching to WebSocket video.

pair.title: Pair a kart
pair.description: Scan the QR with the kart. This dialog closes when pairing finishes.
pair.startingDescription: Preparing the kart network and QR code.

settings.webrtcStunServersHint: One URL per line, e.g. stun:stun.l.google.com:19302. Used for WebRTC video when the viewer is not on the kart's network. Leave blank to use Google's public STUN server.
settings.saved: Settings saved. Restart the daemon to apply changes.
settings.webBindHint: Host and port for the Web UI.
settings.tlsEnabledHint: Uses a self-signed cert when files are empty.
settings.tlsCertHint: Set with the key file, or leave both empty.
settings.videoHwaccelHint: Auto picks the best available backend. Disabled turns off live video.

help.title: Help
help.triggerProportionalDescription: Left stick steers (right stick optional). RT to accelerate; LT to reverse.
help.buttonArcadeDescription: Left stick steers (right stick optional). A to accelerate; B to reverse.

ap.title: Access point
ap.description: LP2P access point on the host. Karts join this network.
ap.notRunningDescription: Start the daemon in normal or pairing mode.

kartDetail.title: Kart details
kartDetail.description: Connected device details and latest status.

keyboardInput.title: Keyboard input
keyboardInput.description: Limit the maximum steering and throttle applied by keyboard input.
keyboardInput.steeringLimitDescription: Maximum left/right steering from keyboard input.
keyboardInput.throttleLimitDescription: Maximum forward/reverse throttle from keyboard input.

touchInput.title: Touch controls
touchInput.description: Show on-screen buttons to steer, brake, and accelerate from a touchscreen.
touchInput.enableDescription: Overlay steering and pedal buttons on the video, like a mobile game.
touchInput.steeringLimitDescription: Maximum left/right steering from touch input.
touchInput.throttleLimitDescription: Maximum forward/reverse throttle from touch input.

gamepadInput.title: Gamepad input
gamepadInput.description: Choose an input mode and tune how controller input reaches the kart.
gamepadInput.connectedDescription: Controller input applies while drive mode is on.
gamepadInput.notConnectedDescription: Connect a gamepad and press any button so the browser can detect it.
gamepadInput.rightStickSteeringDescription: Also accept left/right input from the right stick. Whichever stick is pushed further wins.
gamepadInput.triggerMapping: {{steering}} RT to accelerate; LT to reverse.
gamepadInput.buttonMapping: {{steering}} A to accelerate; B to reverse.
gamepadInput.steeringSensitivityCurveDescription: Sensitivity curve for left/right stick steering.
gamepadInput.throttleSensitivityTriggerDescription: Sensitivity curve for trigger acceleration and reverse.
gamepadInput.throttleSensitivityButtonDescription: Sensitivity curve for A/B button-hold throttle ramp.
gamepadInput.curveHint: Lower values respond faster near center. Higher values give finer control at small inputs.

errors.videoSurfaceNotReady: Video surface is not ready for fullscreen
errors.fullscreenNotSupported: Fullscreen is not supported by this browser
errors.webCodecsRequired: Live video requires WebCodecs over HTTPS. Use HTTPS for LAN access.
